K5_inverted.note: every trigger carried by a perfective form (9 finite, 2 non-finite: 7 gerund, 49 participle); imperfective was available in all 11

SUB_K5_Russian_to_HindiUrdu.note: Russian is the source itself (identity). Vector verbs ask whom the outcome falls to / how it came about, which the perfective never states; 7 gerund (пробыв) and 4 (явилось) only weakly.

SUB_K6_Mongolian_drop.note: 7 of 36 K6 triggers use свой; его/её/их elsewhere already signals non-subject possessor. 73 'был отстранен ... из-за опасений по поводу его …': possessor = passive subject but Russian uses его, so the anchor is not forced in embedded NPs.

numeral_subjects_in_corpus.17: было обнаружено два типа (neuter sg agreement, quantity reading, below five)

K4_Polish_numeral_threshold.note: Russian agreement is free and is used both ways, also below five (17), so the note's 'threshold at five' is imprecise but the conclusion (Polish still forces a choice) holds.

K8_Polish_instrumental_predication.evidence: zero-copula present always nominative (1,13,25,37,38,49,83); являться/стать/служить always instrumental for nouns and adjectives (2,4,19,24,33,57,68); был + instr adj+noun (40, 88) vs был + nom noun (91)
K8_Polish_instrumental_predication.attachment_coverage: only ~22 of 78 K8-trigger sentences contain a copular predication the lens can attach to

unprompted_K5_Finnish_partitive.note: with 94 (убила) as 11th trigger: also settled.
